headline: USA RARE EARTH BECOMES ONE OF FEW WESTERN Dy OXIDE PRODUCERS OUTSIDE ASIA — Recycled Magnets Feed Colorado Hydromet Facility Alongside Round Top and Serra Verde Ore
snippet: USA Rare Earth's hydrometallurgical facility in Wheat Ridge, Colorado has produced commercial-grade dysprosium oxide and neodymium-praseodymium oxide from recycled rare earth magnet scrap — establishing the company as one of the few entities outside Asia capable of executing commercial-scale heavy rare earth separation. The milestone also validates magnet manufacturing waste as a viable feedstock stream, closing a circular loop; follow-on campaigns will process ore from USA Rare Earth's Round Top project and Serra Verde's Pela Ema mine, with further rare earth oxide varieties expected in coming weeks.

headline: AUSTRALIA STRIPS VOTING RIGHTS FROM 3 CHINESE SHAREHOLDERS IN Northern Minerals After Defiance of Divestiture Orders — Most Aggressive Foreign-Investment Enforcement in Rare Earth History
snippet: Australia's government has moved to block three China-linked shareholders of ASX-listed Northern Minerals Ltd. from voting or exercising any shareholder rights after they defied earlier government orders to divest their stakes — a direct enforcement action that escalates Australia's rare earth supply chain security posture beyond any prior intervention. Northern Minerals is advancing the Browns Range heavy rare earth project in Western Australia, one of the few primary dysprosium and terbium development projects outside China.

headline: ARTEMIS GOLD BLACKWATER BREAKS QUARTERLY RECORD — 74,063 oz IN Q2, +20% YoY ON HIGHER GRADES AND THROUGHPUT; ON TRACK FOR 265-290K oz FULL-YEAR TARGET (TSX:ARTG)
snippet: Artemis Gold reported record quarterly production from its Blackwater gold mine in British Columbia, with 74,063 oz produced in Q2 2026 — a 20% year-on-year increase driven by higher feed grades, stronger gold recoveries, and improved mill throughput as the mine's first expansion phase delivers. With 135,986 oz in H1, Artemis is squarely on track to meet full-year guidance of 265,000 to 290,000 ounces as a further expansion stage advances.

headline: OREZONE'S FIRST MULTI-MINE QUARTER HITS PRODUCTION TARGETS — CASA BERARDI WILDFIRE HALTS ONTARIO OPERATIONS TEMPORARILY AFTER JULY 10 IGNITION (TSX:ORE)
snippet: Orezone Gold's Q2 2026 production report marks its first full quarter as a two-mine producer following the acquisition of Hecla Mining's Casa Berardi gold mine in Quebec, with both Bomboré in Burkina Faso and Casa Berardi delivering in line with expectations. A wildfire that ignited approximately 12 kilometres southwest of Casa Berardi on July 10 prompted voluntary suspension of operations; favourable weather and suppression efforts are expected to allow restart in days and Orezone does not expect any impact to its 2026 full-year production guidance.

headline: MONTAGE GOLD LAUNCHES 60,000m 5-RIG DRILL PUSH AT DIDIEVI — 39,963m POST-MRE LAYS GROUNDWORK FOR RESOURCE EXPANSION AT CÔTE D'IVOIRE'S NEXT DEVELOPMENT ASSET (TSX:MAU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Montage Gold Corp.
snippet: Montage Gold has launched a 60,000-metre, five-rig drill program at its Didievi project in Côte d'Ivoire — following completion of 39,963 metres drilled since the last resource estimate of 989,000 oz at 2.5 g/t Au in June 2025 — targeting resource expansion at the Blaffo Guetto deposit and conversion of Inferred to Indicated material, alongside early-stage drilling at the Pokoukro and Gbofia targets. Didievi is positioned as the company's next development project in sequence after the approaching first pour at the Koné gold mine.

headline: OROSUR DRILLS 135.5m AT 1.91 g/t AU AT COLOMBIA'S APTA — HIGH-GRADE CORE INCL. 13.8m AT 12.73 g/t CONFIRMS EXTENSIVE DEEP GOLD SYSTEM AT ANZÁ (TSXV:OMI)
snippet: Orosur Mining (TSXV: OMI) reported July 14 that the second hole at the APTA prospect within its Anzá project in Colombia — MAP107 — returned a composite intersection of 135.5 metres at 1.91 g/t gold, including 49 metres at 4.06 g/t, 26 metres at 7.15 g/t, and a high-grade core of 13.8 metres at 12.73 g/t Au, confirming the deeper gold zone is more extensive than prior modelling indicated. With over 39,000 metres drilled at APTA and the rig now moving east to test shallower mineralisation in MAP108, the results support the case for an eventual Mineral Resource Estimate at one of Colombia's most drilled private gold exploration targets.

headline: POWER METALLIC LION ZONE CONFIRMS 5.26m AT 8.45% CuEq AND 13.30m AT 3.98% — FINAL ASSAYS BEFORE JULY MRE REINFORCE OPEN-PIT CASE IN QUEBEC (TSXV:PNPN)
source_name: Proactive Investors / Power Metallic Mines Inc.
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSXV: PNPN) released what are expected to be among the final assay batches before an initial NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate for the Lion copper-nickel-PGE Zone at its Nisk Project in Quebec — highlights include 5.26 metres at 8.45% copper-equivalent in hole 26-105 and 13.30 metres at 3.98% CuEq in hole 26-115, infill holes on the western side of the Lion deposit confirming high-grade continuity in the near-surface open-pittable portion. The Lion MRE is scheduled for delivery by end of July alongside an updated Nisk resource, after which a preliminary economic assessment is planned immediately.

headline: WORLD'S LARGEST COPPER MINER CHOOSES PROFIT OVER POUNDS — Codelco Chair Fontaine Launches External Audit as $25B Debt and 28-Year Output Low Force Strategic Reset
snippet: Chile's Codelco will pivot to profitability over production growth under new chairman Bernardo Fontaine, who has launched an external audit of the state miner's operations and strategy as it confronts $25 billion in debt and copper output at a 28-year low of approximately 272,000 metric tonnes in Q1 2026 — down 8% year-over-year even as pre-tax profit nearly quadrupled to $825 million on high copper prices. The shift away from output-at-all-costs signals that structural supply growth from the world's dominant copper-producing country will remain constrained regardless of price incentives.

headline: 'GOLD RALLY NIGH, S&P SKY-HIGH': THE CASE FOR WHY THE MINER CORRECTION ENDS AS EQUITIES HIT RECORDS AND FUNDAMENTAL EARNINGS HIT NEAR-RECORDS SIMULTANEOUSLY
snippet: Kitco's July 13 analysis examines an unusual market divergence — the S&P 500 at all-time highs while gold mining equities trade at historically deep discounts to their fundamental earnings — arguing that the same liquidity and macro conditions driving tech stocks to records should be re-rating miners, whose trailing P/Es have collapsed from above 50x to near 20x even as unit profits approach all-time highs. The piece frames this as a structural setup that cannot persist, with the CPI inflection on July 14 as the catalyst that removes the final hawkish overhang blocking the sector's re-rating.
